NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
3542 — 44 North Milwaukee Avenue
From C1-1 to B2-2

The Property
The subject property is located on the southwest side of North Milwaukee Avenue and is improved with a one

story commercial building. The surrounding area along North Milwaukee Avenue is zoned B1-1, B2-2, B2-3,
and C1-1, including the two parcels immediately south of the subject property that are zoned B2-3. These
properties are generally improved with one and two-story buildings used for residential, commercial, and mixed-
use (residential over commercial) purposes. The property also is a Transit Served Location per the Transit
Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance (Section 17-10-0102-B (1)) as it fronts on North Milwaukee
Avenue that is a designated Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment based on CTA bus route 56.

The Project
The Applicant seeks to improve the ground floor of the existing building to create a Business Live/Work Unit that

will serve as his residence and the office for his business. One parking space will be provided for the proposed
use.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 6,250.00 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 4,068.20 sq. ft.(existing)

FAR: 0.66 (existing)

Business Live/Work Units: 1

MLA Density: 4,068.20 sq. ft.

Height: 12.5 ft

Automobile Parking: 1

Bicycle Parking: 1

Setbacks (all existing): Front (N. Milwaukee) 5.20 ft.
Side (Northwest) None
Side (Southeast) 1.89 ft.

Rear (Alley) 30.4 ft.
